applyTo: "docs/**/*.md,*.md"

# Documentation Instructions

- Keep docs concise and concrete.
- Mention routing, scoped tools, permissions, structured outputs, and traceability when documenting runtime behavior.
- Reference the layer model: `web/`, `api/`, `agents/`, `utils/apps/`, `utils/shared/`.
- Keep frontend docs synchronized with React/Vite route and component structure in `docs/routes.md` and `docs/component-map.md`.
- Keep API docs synchronized with `docs/api-contract.md`.
- The canonical rebuild reference is `docs/rebuild-plan.md`.
